At Wireless Wizard LLC, we specialize in making broken phones feel brand new again. From shattered screens and battery replacements to charging port issues and water damage, we provide fast, dependable repairs for all major makes and models. Our team of skilled technicians is passionate about what we do, and we take pride in delivering high-quality service with a personal touch.

With four convenient locations across Mississippi, we’re proud to serve our communities with honesty, transparency, and a commitment to excellence. We don’t believe in shortcuts—only in doing the job right the first time using trusted parts and proven repair techniques. Whether you’re walking in with a cracked screen or just need advice on your device, you’ll always be treated with respect, care, and clear communication.
